name: workshop
notes: Taskdeck-owned runtime hooks and local command-deny rules were retired on 2026-07-31 under #1552. This file remains the T3 authority declaration; user-, organization-, and runtime-level controls are separate effective layers. The maintainer reaffirmed on 2026-08-18 (ADR-0051) that push and merge are agent-executable across all PR classes within explicit task scope once exact-head ci-required.yml and the global review-and-ship gate pass; there is no owner-click or blanket human-review reservation. CODEOWNERS is advisory routing, not merge eligibility. Human legal/licensing/trademark and release decisions, credentials or private data, production mutation, destructive work-loss operations, and repository/environment-settings mutations remain separately scoped. Migrated from legacy .claude/tier.json on 2026-07-27.
